verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an authentication and identity platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of a self-hostable or on-prem deployment of WorkOS. The evidence describes hosted APIs, a hosted UI and a remote MCP server, and community comments only express a wish to run it in their own AWS environment and concerns about data lock-in.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
